vachanas.kannada:
ಲಿಂಗವಂತರ ಲಿಂಗಾಚಾರಿಗಳ ಅಂಗಳಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಗಿ
ಲಿಂಗಾರ್ಪಿತವ ಮಾಡುವಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂದೇಹವಿಲ್ಲದಿರಬೇಕು.
ಅದೆಂತೆಂದಡೆ:
'ಭಿಕ್ಷಲಿಂಗಾರ್ಪಿತಂ ಗತ್ವಾ | ಭಕ್ತಸ್ಯ ಮಂದಿರಂ ತಥಾ |
ಜಾತಿ ಜನ್ಮ ರಜೋಚ್ಫಿಷ್ಟಂ |  ಪ್ರೇತಸ್ಯ ವಿವರ್ಜಿತಃ || '
ಇಂತೆಂದುದಾಗಿ, ಕಾಣದುದನೆ ಚರಿಸದೆ, ಕಂಡುದನು ನುಡಿಯದೆ.
ಕಾಣದುದನು ಕಂಡುದನು ಒಂದೆಸಮವೆಂದು ಅರಿಯಬಲ್ಲರೆ
ಕುಂಭೇಶ್ವರಲಿಂಗವೆಂಬೆನು.
vachanas.transliteration:
liṅgavantara liṅgācārigaḷa aṅgaḷakke hōgi
liṅgārpitava māḍuvalli sandēhavilladirabēku.
adentendaḍe:
'bhikṣaliṅgārpitaṁ gatvā | bhaktasya mandiraṁ tathā |
jāti janma rajōcphiṣṭaṁ |  prētasya vivarjitaḥ || '
intendudāgi, kāṇadudane carisade, kaṇḍudanu nuḍiyade.
kāṇadudanu kaṇḍudanu ondesamavendu ariyaballare
kumbhēśvaraliṅgavembenu.
vachanas.translation:
Going to the house of Liṅga-bearers and observant Liṅgācāris,
One should have not the slightest doubt in offering everything as dedicated to the Liṅga.
How is that so?
"Bhikṣā-liṅgārpitaṁ gatvā | bhaktasya mandiraṁ tathā |
Jāti-janma-rajocchiṣṭaṁ | pretasya vivarjitaḥ ||"
"Having gone to receive alms offered to the Liṅga in the house of a devotee, one should reject only that which is defiled by birth-based impurity, menstrual impurity, or association with the dead."
Do not act upon what you have not perceived, nor speak of what you have not truly seen.
If one can realize that the unseen and the seen are ultimately one and the same,
Then I call him Kumbhēśvaraliṅga.

vachanas.kannada:
ಹದ ಮಣ್ಣಲ್ಲದೆ ಮಡಕೆಯಾಗಲಾರದು.
ವ್ರತಹೀನನ ಬೆರೆಯಲಾಗದು.
ಬೆರೆದಡೆ ನರಕ ತಪ್ಪದು
ನಾನೊಲ್ಲೆ ಬಲ್ಲೆನಾಗಿ, ಕುಂಭೇಶ್ವರಾ.
vachanas.transliteration:
hada maṇṇallade maḍakeyāgalāradu.
vratahīnana bereyalāgadu.
beredaḍe naraka tappadu
nānolle ballenāgi, kumbhēśvarā.
vachanas.translation:
Only well-prepared clay can become a pot.
One must never associate with one who has abandoned the sacred vow.
If one does associate with such a person, hell cannot be avoided.
Knowing this well, I shall never do so, O Kumbhēśvara.
